description: Defines an enumeration 'Topic' representing various MQTT or messaging topics used in the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically in the connectivity module. It includes methods for retrieving topic names, associated pub/sub topics, and finding a topic by name.

classes.name: Topic
classes.description: An enum representing various supported topics related to device twin events, live messages, and commands in the connectivity context.

methods.name: getPubSubTopic
methods.description: Returns the pub/sub topic string used for subscribing to this topic type in the underlying messaging infrastructure.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name string identifier of the topic.

methods.name: forName
methods.description: Static method to find a Topic enum instance by its name; returns an Optional containing the matching Topic if found.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Overrides the default toString method to return the topic name.
